messages:
Alex W: Taking over the on-call shift at 18:00 UTC. There's an ongoing incident impacting /v1/generate with a recent jump in 5xxs (~20% over the last 5m). I can be the incident driver unless someone else wants primary. We need a comms owner to post customer-facing updates.

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert INC-4021 created 6:58:43Z High 5xx rate on inference endpoints. Acknowledged by Jordan P.

Jordan P: I'll grab comms for the next 30 minutes and then hand back. @Maria S can you be secondary and ready to take comms if needed?

Maria S: I can be secondary. Quick question 6 do we plan to attempt scaling first or flip fallbacks immediately?

Alex W: Runbook guidance: 1) attempt to scale model pool, 2) enable a canary fallback to a quantized model, 3) region-level routing to fallback region if capacity can't be added. See https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inc-4021 for details.

Samir: Heads up 6 eu-west Dedicated pools are ~85% GPU util and autoscale may hit quota. That could create a short coverage gap for EU traffic between ~18:10-18:20.

Alex W: @Samir can you check recent autoscale events and any quota failures? If autoscale fails we should prepare a route fallback plan.

Samir: Running checks now. Commands I'm using: 
```bash
kubectl -n inference get hpa -o wide
redwoodctl capacity events --since 15m
```

Samir: Autoscaler triggered twice but failed to allocate GPU due to quota. Opening an infra ticket.

ops-bot: Created INFRA-887 6 Request GPU quota increase for eu-west. Linked to INC-4021. ETA ~30m.

Jordan P: Drafting customer note for #customer-impact: short status update, mention partial fallbacks enabled, scaling attempted, no data loss. Any priority customers to call out?

Maria S: Prioritize top-5 high-RPM customers and any Dedicated tenants in eu-west. I'll review the draft before posting.

Jordan P: Draft posted (to #customer-impact): "We are investigating increased 5xx errors on text-generation endpoints. Partial fallbacks have been enabled and scaling efforts are underway. No customer data loss observed. Estimated mitigation 30-60 minutes. Updates every 15 minutes." :information_source:

Alex W: I'm going to enable a fallback canary to quantized-128 on the canary route in ~2 minutes. If error rate drops we can promote.

incident-bot: Action executed by Alex W: Enabled fallback canary -> quantized-128 (fb-309). Monitoring metrics.

Alex W: 18:07 UTC metrics update: 5xxs dropped from ~20% to ~8% within 2 minutes after enabling the canary. Encouraging sign. Jordan 6 keep running comms; Maria standby for escalation. Samir keep an eye on INFRA-887.

Samir: Pinged infra on-call (@infra-oncall). They acknowledged and are triaging the quota request.

Jordan P: I'll own comms through 18:45 UTC unless someone explicitly takes over. Alex is the technical lead, Maria is backup comms. Logging that in the incident.

Alex W: Leaving handy commands and runbook snippets here for quick reference: 
```text
1) redwoodctl model scale --pool inference-pool --replicas +2
2) redwoodctl feature-toggle set fallback.canary=true --model quantized-128
3) if region quota fails: redwoodctl route update --from-region eu-west --to-region eu-central-fallback
```

Maria S: Copying commands. If we see regression I'll step in and take comms. :eyes: 

Jordan P: Noting a coverage gap risk 6 if INFRA-887 isn't resolved in 15 minutes we should prepare to route eu-west traffic to eu-central fallback. Alex, want me to pre-stage the route change?

Alex W: Pre-stage it and hold execution. Only perform if 5xx > 10% for 5 consecutive minutes or if infra says quota will take >15m. If you execute the route change, update #customer-impact and add a note to the incident timeline.

incident-bot: INC-4021 metadata updated: primary=Alex W, comms=Jordan P, secondary=Maria S, infra_ticket=INFRA-887.

Jordan P: Logging handoff details in this thread. I'll post the next status update at 18:20 UTC. If someone takes over earlier, call it out here. :thumbsup:
